attributes.board_name: Delaware Board of Dentistry and Dental Hygiene

rules.new_licensee_rule: First renewal: licensed less than 1 year as of May 31 of the renewal year - no CPE; 1 to 2 years - half of the required CPE.
rules.alternatives: Board may grant an exception in unusual circumstances (e.g. prolonged illness, extended absence from the country) on petition.
rules.audit_note: Electronic attestation at renewal; random audit each biennium - then upload certificates (name, course, provider, dates, hours) and current CPR card to DELPROS.
rules.accepted_credit_types: Scientific CPE incl. live webinars sponsored/approved by ADA (incl. CERP), ADHA, ADAA, AGD (incl. PACE), recognized dental specialty organizations and study clubs, accredited dental/dental hygiene schools, approved hospital programs, other Board-approved organizations

topics.who: Practitioners with a Delaware controlled substance registration (biennial); plus a one-time 1-hour Delaware law course within the first year of a new registration
Hands-on CPR every 2 years; online CPR not accepted

rules.legal_basis: 24 Del. Admin. Code 1100, Section 6.0 (6.3-6.8); Uniform Controlled Substances Act Regulations 3.1.2-3.1.3
rules.notes: Expires May 31 of even years. Self-study max 30 h (10 h without test, 20 h with test incl. non-live online). Practice management max 10 h. Hands-on CPR every 2 years (online CPR not accepted). Anesthesia permits: 12 h (unrestricted) or 6 h (Restricted I) anesthesia CPE per 6-year re-evaluation.
